title: EPFO Extends ECR Filing Deadline for September 2026 to October 31, 2026
content:
# EPFO Extends ECR Filing Deadline for September 2026 to October 31, 2026

Ek important update hai. Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) ne September 2026 ke Electronic Challan-cum-Return (ECR) filing ki deadline extend karne ka announce kiya hai.

Employers aur establishments ke liye yeh ek welcome relief hai, especially after the recent wage ceiling revision.

*   **Old Due Date:** Pehle September 2026 wage month ke ECR filing aur contribution remittance ki due date October 15, 2026 thi.
*   **New Due Date:** Ab yeh deadline extend hokar **October 31, 2026** ho gayi hai.
*   **Reason for Extension:** Yeh extension statutory PF wage ceiling ko ₹15,000 se ₹25,000 per month karne ki wajah se diya gaya hai, jo September 17, 2026 se effective hua tha. Employers ko payroll systems update karne aur employee-wise contribution calculations mein jo difficulties aa rahi thi, unhe address karne ke liye yeh extra time diya gaya hai.
*   **Circular Details:** EPFO ne is extension ko October 13, 2026 ko ek official circular ke through announce kiya hai, under Paragraph 28(3) of the Employees' Provident Funds Scheme, 1952.

Toh, date extend ho gayi hai, establishments ko ab additional time mil gaya hai to complete their compliance accurately.
